caption_en:
Two numbers, one country. The gap is the story. 🔍

Is Israel a violent country? Now with the latest data.

Murders per 100,000 people, UNODC data (via Our World in Data, June 2026 update), latest year each country reported:
Germany 0.9 (2023), Saudi Arabia 0.9 (2019), Jordan 1.0 (2023), Egypt 1.3 (2017), Syria 2.1 (2010), Lebanon 2.2 (2020), Iran 2.4 (2014), Turkey 3.2 (2023), USA 5.8 (2023).
Israel: 1.6 in 2022 (UNODC, its latest). 2024: about 2.8 (Taub Center count of 278 victims: 220 Arab, 58 Jewish; Israel CBS population 10,027,000, end of 2024). Israel has no UNODC figure for 2023 yet, so the race jumps from 2022 to 2024.

Now split Israel in two (2024):
Jewish Israelis: 58 victims, about 0.8 per 100,000. Lower than Germany.
Arab Israelis: 220 victims, about 10.5 per 100,000. Almost double the USA.
Taub Center: Arab citizens are 14 times more likely to be murdered.
2025: 252 Arab citizens killed, the deadliest year on record (Abraham Initiatives).

Most Arab and Jewish Israelis live in peace. Many of the victims are peaceful Arab citizens caught between Arab crime organisations and smuggled guns. The state is failing to protect them.
Small print: some governments undercount, Taub's count leaves out terror attacks, and war deaths are not in these numbers. Gaps between reported years are filled in a straight line.

Sources: UNODC intentional homicide rate via Our World in Data (2026); Taub Center homicide update (Feb 2025); Israel CBS population, end of 2024; Abraham Initiatives 2025 summary report.
Photos: Sakhnin, Shlomo Rodded (PikiWiki), CC BY 2.5; Supreme Court, israeltourism, CC BY 2.0; Tel Aviv, Maqaf Ivri, CC BY-SA 4.0.
Made with AI tools. AI voice (Noam's own cloned voice).
caption_he:
ישראל מדינה אלימה? עכשיו עם הנתונים העדכניים.

רציחות לכל 100,000 תושבים (UNODC). ישראל: 1.6 ב-2022, וכ-2.8 ב-2024 (מרכז טאוב והלמ"ס).
כשמפצלים את ישראל (2024): יהודים כ-0.8 (פחות מגרמניה), ערבים כ-10.5 (כמעט פי 2 מארה"ב). פי 14.
2025: 252 אזרחים ערבים נרצחו, השנה הקטלנית ביותר שנרשמה (יוזמות אברהם).

רוב הערבים והיהודים בישראל חיים בשלום. רבים מהקורבנות הם אזרחים ערבים שלווים שנקלעו בין ארגוני פשיעה לנשק מוברח. המדינה לא מצליחה להגן עליהם.
